dek: Alibaba's Tongyi Wanxiang team has open-sourced Wan-Animate-2, an end-to-end character animation framework that runs at 24 fps in real-time streaming without skeletal pose extraction. Head-to-head comparisons show parity with closed-source commercial leaders.
